description: This file defines the QueryFactory class in Drupal, responsible for creating entity query objects for configuration entities, managing key-value stores, and handling configuration events.

classes.name: QueryFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating configuration entity queries and managing related key-value stores and event handling.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Creates a new Query object for a given entity type and conjunction.

methods.name: getAggregate
methods.description: Throws an exception as aggregation over configuration entities is not supported.

methods.name: getConfigKeyStore
methods.description: Retrieves the key-value store used for fast lookups for a specific entity type.

methods.name: updateConfigKeyStore
methods.description: Updates the key-value store with lookup data for a configuration entity.

methods.name: deleteConfigKeyStore
methods.description: Removes lookup data from the key-value store for a configuration entity.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Creates lookup keys for configuration data based on specified key and method.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Recursively finds all values for a configuration key within a config object.

methods.name: onConfigSave
methods.description: Handles configuration save events to update the key-value store.

methods.name: onConfigDelete
methods.description: Handles configuration delete events to remove entries from the key-value store.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this class subscribes to for configuration save and delete.
